data.narrative:
Starcloud is a Seed-stage Space & Aerospace company currently valued at $1.1B post-money, having raised $170M to date. The comparable universe comprises 8 private peers in the same sector at similar valuation tiers, alongside 5 public Space & Aerospace companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) that serve as sector anchors.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage multiplier to the $1.1B last post-money valuation, yields $2.8B. Peer-median analysis across 8 same-sector comparables—including Impulse Space ($4.3B), Firefly Aerospace ($2.9B), Apex Space ($2.3B), and Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B)—produces a median of $1.8B, with a range spanning $840M to $4.3B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied; the median P/S multiple for the 6-ticker Space & Aerospace sector is 27.4x, but Starcloud's revenue is not disclosed.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.5B (low) to $3.2B (high), with a median of $2.3B. Key uncertainties include the timing and terms of the next funding round (which would validate the stage-progression step-up) and the high dispersion within the peer set, reflecting heterogeneous business models and maturity levels in frontier aerospace. The current $1.1B valuation sits in the lower quartile of identified peers.
